> # Nano Banana 2.1
> Nano Banana 2.1 is a member of the Gemini 3 series of models, a suite of highly-capable, natively multimodal reasoning models.
> Nano Banana 2.1 is based on Gemini 3.6 Flash.
> Text strings (e.g., a prompt, document(s)) and images, with a token context window of up to 1M.
> Image, with a 4K token output and text, with a 64K token output.
> Distribution: Gemini App, Google AI Studio, Gemini API, Google Search AI Mode, Google Ads, Google Flow, Google Stitch.
> The knowledge cutoff date for Gemini 3.6 Flash is March 2026
